info.name: 📌 Google Gemini API & Vertex AI API
info.description:
| Feature | Gemini API | Vertex AI API |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Authentication | API key | IAM access |
| Use Case | Prototyping | Production |
| Enterprise Support | No | Yes |
| MLOps | No | Full MLOps tools |
| Data Residency | No control | Customizable |

### About

"Gemini platform is a comprehensive platform for developers to build, scale, govern and optimize agents."

Google builds its own Gemini, Gemma, Nano Banana and Veo models. The Gemini API serves them directly, and Vertex AI on Google Cloud also hosts models from other labs. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Cloud platforms**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Google Account (Gemini): [https://aistudio.google.com/](https://aistudio.google.com/)
    
- Google Cloud Account (Vertex AI): [https://cloud.google.com/](https://cloud.google.com/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add these keys to your **Postman Vault** as `google_gemini_api_key`, `google_vertex_ai_access_token` (Vertex AI only) (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using these exact names). Requests read them as `{{vault:google_gemini_api_key}}` and so on, so your key never leaves your device. Vertex AI requests also need your Google Cloud project in the `projectId` collection variable, and a Vertex access token from `gcloud auth print-access-token`.

### Documentation

- API (Gemini): [https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/quickstart?lang=rest](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/quickstart?lang=rest)
    
- API (Vertex AI): [https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/overview](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/overview)
    
- Models (Gemini): [https://ai.google/get-started/our-models/](https://ai.google/get-started/our-models/)
    
- Models (Vertex AI): [https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/inference#supported-models](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/inference#supported-models)
    
- OpenAI Compatible: [https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai)
